expectations.text: Provides an executable pull command with the correct run_id
Targets the prod MLflow tracking server
expectations.evidence: `--env prod` used throughout; troubleshooting section warns against mixing envs
Explicitly picks tag from existing test-repo conventions (`duration_notime_xgb_*`, etc.) and shows 22042026 date
